    Based on the 2024 US Open, Northern Irish professional golfer Rory McIlroy (often misspelled McElroy) was born on May 4, 1989. As of June 20, 2024, he was 35 years old. 
    • Born: May 4, 1989
    • Age as of June 2024: 35
    • Nationality: Northern Irish 
    Please note this refers to the 4-time major winning golfer Rory McIlroy. Other individuals with similar names, such as former NFL player Ray McElroy (born 1972) or New Zealand politician Roy McElroy (1907-1994), are distinct people.

    Is Rory McIlroy still with his wife?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, Rory McIlroy is still with his wife, Erica Stoll. Although McIlroy filed for divorce in May 2024, citing that their marriage was "irretrievably broken," the couple voluntarily dismissed the divorce petition one month later, reconciling and confirming they would continue their future as a family together. 
    Key Details on Their Relationship: 
    • Marriage: The couple has been married since April 2017.
    • Family: They have a daughter named Poppy, born in 2020.
    • Current Status: Reports from early 2026 show them together, with Stoll supporting McIlroy at events like the Masters and the Players Championship
      .
    • Resolution: After the briefly filed divorce, they worked through their differences to maintain their family unit.
